_about: Extra Pinterest pins made from existing looks, every one angled at people dressing for Dubai/the UAE. scripts/make_pin_variants.py renders each pin to assets/pins/<id>.jpg and writes pinterest/bulk-upload.csv (Pinterest bulk-create format) with the pins not yet uploaded, filling the daily 'times_utc' slots (UTC) from 'start', in the order listed. Pins marked 'uploaded' are already scheduled on Pinterest at their 'when' ('' = posted on upload) and are left out. Types: headline = the look's collage with a keyword headline band; piece = one product large on the look's backdrop; formula = 4 pieces with plus signs; still = product-only still life; palette = hero piece + colour chips. Every description starts with the tap-to-shop line.
